answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. An identity earns only when its spiral recurs, its oasis survives audit, and a zenith from an unlinked peer confirms it.
